commons.description: The hilt has a copper ring at its base and is shaped like a squatting Hindu deity. The crosspiece is made of ivory and has a boat-like design; the sheath is composed of wood that has been inlaid with gold foil pieces and adorned with coloured gemstones. The Kris blade is damascened and contains seven waves. It is over a century old.
